evidence.dwelling_unit: Dwelling Unit in a permitted residential building type

calculation_handling.description: Lists the uses permitted in the RD zone: a dwelling unit in a permitted residential building type (Clause 10.20.20.40) and a municipal shelter park. No numeric bound.
calculation_handling.gaps: Municipal Shelter Park has no vocab.uses token; it is not keyed as an application use.

10.20.20.10(1).explanation: In the RD (Residential Detached) zone, homes are allowed as dwelling units in the building types that Clause 10.20.20.40 permits; a municipal shelter park is also a permitted use.
